### `design.theme_prompt` — Theme-from-Prompt

Generates a complete, contrast-verified theme from a description such as “calm fintech at night”.

**Why it exists.** A theme is forty coupled decisions; a sentence should be enough to make all of them coherently.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `theme` — Applies design tokens to the document. |
| Binds to | `Page`, `Shell` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `prompt` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `name` | string |
| `brand` | string |
| `accent` | string |
| `dark` | boolean |
| `radius` | integer |
| `font` | one of `sans`, `serif`, `mono`, `rounded` |
| `density` | one of `compact`, `comfortable`, `spacious` |
| `rationale` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.page("Quarterly review").ai("design.theme_prompt")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("design.theme_prompt", {"prompt": "calm fintech at night"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "name": "Calm Fintech Night",
  "brand": "#008b96",
  "accent": "#37b2e8",
  "dark": true,
  "radius": 12,
  "font": "sans",
  "density": "spacious",
  "rationale": "Built around “calm” with low chroma, moderate corners and a dark scheme.",

    {
      "name": "--fl-bg",
      "value": "#081011"
    },
    {
      "name": "--fl-surface",
      "value": "#11191a"
    },
    {
      "name": "--fl-surface-2",
      "value": "#1a2223"
    },
    "… 28 more"
  ]
}
```

### `design.palette` — Palette Harmonizer

Expands one seed colour into an 11-step perceptual ramp plus complementary, analogous and triadic harmonies.

**Why it exists.** Ramps built in HSL have uneven steps; OKLCH ramps look even and keep contrast predictable.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |
| Model tier | — |
| Surface | `theme` — Applies design tokens to the document. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `seed` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `ramp` | list of object {step, value} |
| `complementary` | string |
| `analogous` | list of string |
| `triadic` | list of string |
| `neutral` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text("Se\u00f1or \u03a9 \u2713 \u2014 \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \ud83d\ude80").ai("design.palette")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("design.palette", {"seed": "#2f6bff"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

### `design.contrast_heal` — Contrast Healer

Checks text/background pairs against WCAG and repairs failures by shifting lightness while preserving hue.

**Why it exists.** Contrast failures are the most common accessibility defect and the most mechanical to fix.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |
| Model tier | — |
| Surface | `theme` — Applies design tokens to the document. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pairs` | list of object {fg, bg, name, target} | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `pairs` | list of object {name, fg, bg, ratio, fixed, fixedRatio, passes, note} |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text("Se\u00f1or \u03a9 \u2713 \u2014 \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \ud83d\ude80").ai("design.contrast_heal")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("design.contrast_heal", {"pairs": [{"name": "muted on white", "fg": "#9db8ff", "bg": "#ffffff"}]})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "pairs": [
    {
      "name": "muted on white",
      "fg": "#9db8ff",
      "bg": "#ffffff",
```

### `design.dark_mode` — Dark-Mode Derivation

Derives a dark theme from a light brand: re-tuned surfaces, lifted brand colour, verified contrast — not inversion.

**Why it exists.** Inverting colours produces muddy, low-contrast dark modes; derivation keeps the brand recognisable.

| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |

### `design.token_lint` — Token Linter

Flags hard-coded colours and off-grid sizes and maps each to the nearest design token.

**Why it exists.** Design systems erode one hex code at a time.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |
| Model tier | — |
| Surface | `audit` — A findings list with severities; selecting a finding highlights its target. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | list of string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `score` | number |
| `summary` | string |
| `findings` | list of object {id, severity, title, detail, target, fix} |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text("Se\u00f1or \u03a9 \u2713 \u2014 \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \ud83d\ude80").ai("design.token_lint")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("design.token_lint", {"values": ["#2e6bfe", "13px", "16px"]})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "score": 96.0,
  "summary": "2 token findings: 0 blocking, 0 to improve.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "tokens.raw-colour",
      "severity": "info",
      "title": "Raw colour #2e6bfe",
      "detail": "Hard-coded colours drift from the theme.",
      "target": null,
      "fix": "Use var(--fl-brand) (distance 0.014)."
    },
    {
      "id": "tokens.off-grid",
      "severity": "info",
      "title": "Off-grid size 13px",
      "detail": "Sizes should sit on the 4px grid.",
      "target": null,
      "fix": "Use 12px."
    }
  ]
}
```

### `design.voice_lint` — Voice & Tone Lint

**Why it exists.** Voice consistency is a brand asset that no one has time to police by hand.

### `design.motion` — Motion Choreographer

Specifies duration, easing and movement for a transition from what the change means.

**Why it exists.** Motion communicates causality; arbitrary durations communicate nothing.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `intent` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `kind` | string |
| `durationMs` | integer |
| `easing` | string |
| `movement` | string |
| `reducedMotion` | string |
| `rationale` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("design.motion", {"intent": "row deleted from table"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "kind": "enter",
  "durationMs": 200,
  "easing": "cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1)",
  "movement": "fade + 8px up",
  "reducedMotion": "Opacity-only cross-fade, 120ms, no translation or scale.",
  "rationale": "Enter motion should be quick and decelerating so the change reads as cause and effect."
}
```

### `design.spacing` — Rhythm & Spacing Advisor

Audits spacing rhythm: inner gaps larger than outer gaps, too many scale steps, manual spacers.

**Why it exists.** Consistent rhythm is what makes a layout feel designed; it is also easy to check mechanically.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `audit` — A findings list with severities; selecting a finding highlights its target. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | yes |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scene` | any | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `score` | number |
| `summary` | string |
| `findings` | list of object {id, severity, title, detail, target, fix} |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text("Se\u00f1or \u03a9 \u2713 \u2014 \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \ud83d\ude80").ai("design.spacing")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("design.spacing", {"scene": {"type": "Stack", "props": {"gap": "sm"}, "children": [{"type": "Stack", "props": {"…": "1 keys"}, "children": [{"…": "2 keys"}]}, {"type": "Spacer"}]}})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "score": 92.0,
  "summary": "2 spacing findings: 0 blocking, 1 to improve.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "rhythm.inverted",
      "severity": "warning",
      "title": "Inner gap larger than outer gap",
      "detail": "Related items (xl) sit further apart than unrelated groups (sm).",
      "target": "_r.0",
      "fix": "Make inner spacing tighter than outer spacing."
    },
    {
      "id": "rhythm.spacer",
      "severity": "info",
      "title": "Manual spacer",
      "detail": "Spacers bypass the spacing scale.",
      "target": "_r.1",
      "fix": "Use the parent's gap instead."
    }
  ]
}
```
